description: National Procurement Commission -  Procurement Guide Lines - 2024 On Goods, Works and Non Consulting Services.
reasoning: This gazette contains the publication of new procurement guidelines by the National Procurement Commission under constitutional authority. It establishes a regulatory framework for government procurement processes, including detailed procedures, compliance requirements, and legal standards for public procurement of goods, works, and services. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it creates binding rules and procedures rather than addressing government personnel changes or organizational structure.
